entities.summary: Riley James Minix is an American professional basketball player for the Cleveland Cavaliers of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Cleveland Charge of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Southeastern Fire and the Morehead State Eagles.
